settings.text: Consignment
Let us find the right buyer

Consignment means we sell your cards on your behalf rather than buying them from you. You keep ownership until a card sells, and you get the benefit of us photographing, describing, pricing and listing it properly. It suits collections worth taking time over — and it takes longer than selling to us outright.
How consignment works
Tell us what you have
Send the card name, set, card number and condition for each item, with clear photos. We'll tell you whether consignment is the right route or whether you'd be better off selling to us outright.
Send your cards in
Once we've agreed what we're taking, we'll confirm how to package and send your cards, and what happens when they arrive.
We photograph, price and list
We shoot each card, describe its condition, price it against the current market and put it in front of buyers.
The terms that matter
Anything marked [To confirm] is still being finalised. We'd rather leave it blank than publish a number we might have to change — ask us and we'll tell you where it stands.
Commission
[To confirm — commission rate or tiers.] We'll agree the rate with you in writing before anything is listed, so you know exactly what you'll receive on a sale.
What we take
[To confirm — minimum value and accepted categories.] As a guide we're most useful for cards that need a buyer who knows what they're looking at, rather than bulk.
Pricing and repricing
You'll agree a starting price with us. If a card sits without interest we'll come back to you before changing anything — we won't quietly discount your card.
Getting paid
[To confirm — payout method and schedule.] We'll set out how and when you're paid after a sale before you send anything in.
If a card doesn't sell
[To confirm — unsold card policy and any return postage costs.] Your cards stay yours throughout, and you can ask for them back.
Looking after your cards
[To confirm — storage and insurance arrangements.] We won't claim cover we haven't arranged, so this will be spelled out in your agreement rather than implied here.
Start a consignment enquiry

Tell us roughly what you have — how many cards, which sets or eras, and anything you think stands out. This form doesn't take attachments, so send what you can here and we'll reply so you can share photos. Getting in touch doesn't commit you to anything.
Consignment questions

settings.heading: Should I consign or sell outright?

settings.text: Selling outright is faster and simpler: we make an offer, you accept or decline, and it's done. Consignment usually suits cards that need the right buyer to come along. Tell us what you have and we'll say honestly which one we think fits — including when we think you'd do better selling to us.

settings.heading: Do I still own my cards?

settings.text: Yes. Consigned cards remain yours until they sell. Nothing changes hands in ownership terms just because a card is listed.

settings.heading: How long does it take to sell?

settings.text: There's no fixed answer, and we won't invent one. It depends entirely on the card, the price you've agreed and who's looking at the time. We'll keep you updated rather than leave you guessing.

settings.heading: Can I take my cards back?

settings.text: Yes. If you want to withdraw a card, tell us and we'll arrange it. [To confirm — any notice period and who covers return postage.]
[To confirm — commission rate or tiers.] Whatever we agree will be confirmed in writing before your cards are listed. You'll never find out what you're paying after the fact.
